about_the_game:
Step into the driver’s seat of a massive semi-truck and take on the ultimate test of precision driving. Rookie to Master Driver is a skill-based parking simulator where every turn, every reverse, and every inch matters.

Start in the training yard, learning the basics of trailer control, tight turns, and S-curves. Progress through increasingly demanding challenges — from narrow warehouses and busy ports to winding countryside roads. Each level is carefully designed to push your technique to the limit, rewarding patience, accuracy, and determination.

This is not an open-world trucking game. Instead, it’s a focused journey from rookie to master, built around handcrafted scenarios that highlight the thrill and frustration of maneuvering a giant machine through spaces that barely fit.

Do you have the discipline to control twenty meters of steel, or will you jackknife under pressure? Every mistake is a lesson. Every success brings you closer to mastery.
